data.title: 法琳 · 秘境溪流边的赤足回眸
data.description: 阳光穿透繁茂的迷宫密林顶冠，在清澈见底的溪流上洒下点点光斑。法琳提起床袍裙角，赤足踏入清凉潺潺的溪水中。水花溅起打湿了她的小腿，她转过身来，金发在光束中宛如发光的金丝，微红着脸颊朝岸边的同伴伸出白皙的手掌，发出温柔的邀请。
data.action: lifting robe skirt, wading barefoot in stream, reaching out hand, radiant smile
data.lighting: ethereal god rays filtering through forest canopy
data.promptProse: Wading barefoot into a crystal-clear forest stream, Falin Touden lifts the hem of her travel robe above the ripples. God rays stream through the lush canopy, illuminating her glowing golden hair as she reaches out a hand with an enchanting, gentle smile.
data.animaCaption: Falin wading barefoot in a sunlit stream reaching out her hand.
